title: Generating 26 Warm Leads for a Pharma Packaging Manufacturer
challenge: A pharmaceutical packaging manufacturer relied heavily on exhibitions, existing customers and offline introductions. The company wanted a more predictable way to reach growing pharmaceutical brands.
solution: Myntmore developed outreach campaigns segmented by pharmaceutical category and packaging requirements. LinkedIn content highlighted production quality, customisation, material selection and supply timelines. Follow-ups were designed to initiate technical discussions rather than push immediate sales.
results: 21% positive response rate among engaged prospects.
New conversations with pharmaceutical procurement and operations leaders.
